title: Simple Mode: just type and get a song

body.text: The easiest mode is to type a description in the
box and click Create — Suno writes both the melody and lyrics. The tip is to include
in one sentence. The clearer it is, the more on-target the result.

example: A fun country song encouraging hard-working people, fast tempo, male vocals

title: Specify language and vocals

body.text: For a Thai song, say so directly:
, and specify the vocals — like 'female vocals', 'male vocals', 'deep and soft'. If you don't, Suno guesses, which may give a language or tone you didn't want.

example: A slow, sad R&B song about saying goodbye, in Thai, soft female vocals

question: In Simple Mode, what should you include in the description?

options.text: Only the name of an artist to imitate

question: If you want a Thai song, what should you do?

options.text: Let Suno guess on its own
Put the word 'in Thai' in the prompt
Always write the prompt in English

question: Which prompt gives the most on-target result?

options.text: 'A bright, uplifting pop song, mid tempo, in Thai, female vocals'

question: What happens if you don't specify the vocals?

options.text: Suno picks for you, which may not match your taste
The song will have no vocals at all
